_comment: Fail-closed routing policy. 'remote' defaults to 'disabled', which keeps the LYA project rule that speech text is never sent to a third party without an explicit owner decision. Nothing is enabled by default.

neural_edge._comment: Primary quality voice (Microsoft Edge neural). Opt-in only.

cloud_edge._comment: Older file-at-a-time remote engine; kept for comparison.

audit._comment: store_text stays false: only a salted hash prefix of the spoken text is logged.

cache._comment: Disabled by default. When enabled, files are keyed by a hash of plan+voice and never contain the source text.
